questions.question: Milk, seafood, nuts and whole grains are high in which mineral that helps with bone health and our body's repair process?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Phosphorus**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Phosphorus** is a crucial mineral found in milk, seafood, nuts, and whole grains.
 
• It plays a vital role in **bone health** by working with calcium to build strong bones and teeth.
 
• Phosphorus is also essential for the **body's repair process** and the formation of DNA and RNA.
 
• This mineral helps in the **metabolism of fats and carbohydrates**, and the production of ATP, which is the energy currency of the cell.
 
• Maintaining adequate levels of phosphorus is important for overall health and bodily functions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Calcium and phosphorus** work together to maintain bone strength; a balance of these minerals is necessary for optimal bone health.
 
• Foods rich in phosphorus include **dairy products, fish, meat, and whole grains.**
 
• Phosphorus deficiency can lead to **weakness, bone pain, and increased susceptibility to infections.**
 
• It is important to consume phosphorus in moderation, as excessive intake can cause health issues such as kidney damage and cardiovascular disease.
 
• The recommended daily intake of phosphorus for adults is approximately **700 mg**.

questions.question: What is capital expenditure?

options.text: Amount spent on subsidy for farmers

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Amount spent on infrastructure development**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Capital expenditure** refers to the amount spent by an organization or government on acquiring, maintaining, or improving fixed assets such as buildings, vehicles, equipment, or land.
 
• It is considered an investment in the long-term assets of the organization or country, which will provide benefits over several years.
 
• Examples of capital expenditure include spending on **infrastructure development, purchasing machinery, upgrading technology,** and constructing new facilities.
 
• Such expenditures are essential for the growth and development of both public and private sectors, as they enhance the productive capacity and efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Capital expenditure is different from **operational expenditure** (OpEx), which refers to the costs required for the day-to-day functioning of an organization, such as salaries, utilities, and rent.
 
• Capital expenditures are usually recorded as assets on the balance sheet, while operational expenditures are recorded as expenses on the income statement.
 
• Effective management of capital expenditure is crucial for long-term financial planning and sustainability.
 
• Governments often allocate a significant portion of their budgets to capital expenditures to promote economic growth and improve public services.

questions.question: Laterite soil develops as a result of which of the following reasons?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Leaching**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Leaching** is the primary process responsible for the development of laterite soil.
 
• Laterite soil forms in regions with high rainfall and temperature, which leads to intense leaching of silica and bases from the soil.
 
• This process results in the concentration of iron and aluminum oxides, giving laterite soil its characteristic reddish color.
 
• Leaching removes soluble substances from the soil, leaving behind oxides of iron and aluminum.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Laterite soils** are typically found in tropical and subtropical regions.
 
• They are poor in nutrients due to the extensive leaching process.
 
• Laterite soils are often used for building materials due to their hardness when dry.
 
• These soils require proper management and fertilization for agricultural use.

questions.question: Bhitargaon Brick temple is a good example of the architecture of which of the following periods?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gupta period**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bhitargaon Brick temple is an excellent example of architecture from the **Gupta period**.
 
• Located in Uttar Pradesh, India, it is one of the oldest surviving brick temples in the country.
 
• The temple showcases the **architectural and artistic advancements** made during the Gupta era, which is often referred to as the "Golden Age" of India.
 
• The structure is known for its **ornate terracotta panels** and intricate carvings, reflecting the high level of craftsmanship of that time.
 
• The Gupta period (approximately 4th to 6th century CE) is renowned for its significant contributions to Indian art, culture, and architecture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Gupta Empire, founded by Sri Gupta, saw a great flourishing of **literature, science, and the arts**.
 
• Famous scholars like **Kalidasa** and **Aryabhata** emerged during this period.
 
• The period is also known for the development of the **classical forms of Indian dance and music**.
 
• Many of the temples and structures built during the Gupta period have influenced later architectural styles in India.

questions.question: 'Autobiography of a Yogi' is the autobiography of __________.
questions.solution:

• Paramahansa Yogananda was a spiritual teacher and yogi who founded the Self-Realization Fellowship to disseminate his teachings.
 
• The autobiography is considered a spiritual classic and has inspired millions of readers worldwide.
 
• It details Yogananda's encounters with spiritual figures of both the East and West and his journey towards self-realization.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Paramahansa Yogananda** was born on January 5, 1893, in Gorakhpur, India, and passed away on March 7, 1952, in Los Angeles, USA.
 
• He is credited with bringing the teachings of meditation and Kriya Yoga to the United States.
 
• The Self-Realization Fellowship continues to publish his works and teachings, making them accessible to a global audience.
 
• 'Autobiography of a Yogi' has been translated into over 50 languages and remains a popular book for those interested in spirituality and self-realization.

• He was a key figure in the struggle against British colonial rule and sought to achieve independence through armed struggle.
 
• Bose's famous slogan was "**Give me blood, and I shall give you freedom!**"
 
• He formed the **Azad Hind Government** in exile during World War II and sought support from Axis powers to fight against the British.
 
• Despite his controversial alliances, Bose remains a revered figure in Indian history for his dedication and sacrifices for the nation's independence.

questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution secures a decent standard of living for all workers with a living wage and social and cultural opportunities?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 43**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 43** of the Indian Constitution secures a decent standard of living for all workers with a living wage and social and cultural opportunities.
 
• It falls under the Directive Principles of State Policy, which are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government.
 
• The aim is to ensure that the state makes effective provisions for securing the right to work, education, and public assistance in cases of unemployment, old age, sickness, and disablement.
 
• These principles are fundamental in the governance of the country and aim to create social and economic conditions under which the citizens can lead a good life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Directive Principles of State Policy** are enumerated in Part IV of the Constitution of India from Articles 36 to 51.
 
• They are not enforceable by any court, but the principles laid down therein are considered fundamental in the governance of the country.
 
• These principles aim to create social and economic conditions under which the citizens can lead a good life and are instrumental in the establishment of a welfare state.
 
• The Directive Principles are inspired by the Irish Constitution and reflect the ideals that the founding fathers of the Indian Constitution aimed to achieve.
 
• They encompass a wide range of socio-economic rights including the right to an adequate means of livelihood, equal pay for equal work, protection of childhood and youth against exploitation, and provisions for just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief.

questions.question: 95-year-old Bhagwani Devi and 106-year-old Ramabai were jointly awarded the BBC Special trophy for their achievements where Devi won the gold medal in the 100m sprint at the ___________ in Tampere, Finland.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2022 World Masters Athletics Championships**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **95-year-old Bhagwani Devi** and **106-year-old Ramabai** were jointly awarded the BBC Special trophy for their achievements in senior athletics.
 
• Bhagwani Devi won the gold medal in the **100m sprint** at the **2022 World Masters Athletics Championships** held in Tampere, Finland.
 
• The event celebrates the athletic achievements of senior athletes from around the world, providing a platform for competition and recognition.
 
• The **World Masters Athletics Championships** is an international event that encourages older athletes to participate in track and field events, promoting fitness and healthy competition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **World Masters Athletics Championships** are held biennially and are open to athletes aged 35 and above.
 
• The event includes a wide range of track and field disciplines, including sprints, distance running, jumping, and throwing events.
 
• Participants compete in age groups, ensuring fair competition among peers of similar age.
 
• These championships highlight the importance of lifelong fitness and the remarkable capabilities of senior athletes.

questions.question: TN Rajarathnam Pillai is a player of which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nadhaswaram**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **TN Rajarathnam Pillai** is renowned for his mastery of the **Nadhaswaram**, a traditional South Indian wind instrument.
 
• The **Nadhaswaram** is considered one of the world's loudest non-brass acoustic instruments.
 
• It is a key instrument in South Indian classical music and is often used in temple ceremonies and traditional festivals.
 
• TN Rajarathnam Pillai is celebrated for his significant contributions to the popularization and elevation of the **Nadhaswaram** in classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **TN Rajarathnam Pillai** was born on August 27, 1898, and he passed away on December 12, 1956.
 
• He is often referred to as the **"Nadhaswara Chakravarthy"** (Emperor of Nadhaswaram).
 
• His music style is noted for its emotional depth and technical proficiency, which has inspired many subsequent musicians.
 
• The **Nadhaswaram** itself is a double-reed instrument, similar to the North Indian shehnai but larger and with a more robust sound.
 
• Pillai's performances have left a lasting legacy in the field of Carnatic music, and his recordings are still revered today.
